Title: Questions about Sabbat cards [Hey, Scalpel!] <- Silly

Messages.Author: Kristofer Wårell
Messages.Body:
I have questions about two cards from Sabbat, first a vampire:

Dominique Ventrue Antitribu
Capacity: 7 Disciplines: ani AUS dom FOR vic
Sabbat: As a (D) action, Dominique may put a vandal counter on a
location. If a location has a number of vandal counters equal to its
cost, burn it.
Artist: Tim Bradstreet & Grant Goleash

What's up with 0-cost locations?

a) Instant burn when Dominique enters play.
b) Cannot be burned by Dominique.
c) Is burned when the first vandal counter is put on it.

Personally I think c) is the most reasonable, while a) would be too
harsh and
b) would make no sense (Why would some locations be impossible to
vandalize?).

The other is a library card:

Scouting Mission Action Dominate
Normal: maneuver or press with weapons.
Superior: This action is at +1 stealth. A younger, uncontrolled
vampire
gains 2 blood from the blood bank.
Artist: Scott Fischer Rarity: Common

Exactly how are the inferior version supposed to work?

a) Provided the minion have a weapon, he/she can make a maneuver or
press.
b) ???

I guess a) is the way is supposed to be, but I don't like the wording
(not
implying that my wording is any better).

Sincerely, Kristofer Wårell
